en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's play basketball
Ah, maybe we should take off our clothes...?
Let's warm up a bit
Is this a request?
If so, please tell me what your objective is.

If it is for leisure,
I will not give my fullest capabilities.

If you wish to test your ability, then I will
challenge you with all my power.
What is the purpose of this?

Depending on how you answer,
I will take the appropriate action.
I am your maid, not your slave.

If you are thinking of vulgar thoughts, then I
advise you to be more aware of the situation.
That is a great idea.

If you were ever harmed during exercise with
me by your side...I would fail as a maid.

Well then, shall we do an elaborate
training regimen?

You might experience muscle ache at
first, but please try to relax.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kirumi looks deep in thought...
(How should I...?)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kirumi's inner thoughts...?
